sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: This case tests whether federal trust duties allow tribes to sue for money. The government says sovereign immunity blocks these suits. The tribe says trust principles create enforceable legal duties.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: This dispute defines the scope of federal accountability to tribes. It determines whether tribes can recover money for government errors. The outcome shapes future tribal-government financial relationships.
